scope: Foot location proposals; no contact labels or ground truth accuracy

method.rtmInput: precomputed E-BARD player box, 1.25 padding by rtmlib
method.yoloInput: full frame; one-to-one descending IoU match >= 0.4
method.candidateRule: >=2 accepted landmarks per foot; mean each foot, then mean accepted feet
method.timing: warm inference + preprocess + postprocess; excludes decode/load/warmup/render/write and E-BARD detection

summary.note: Coverage and displacement are not accuracy; poses and boxes can both be wrong.
